outcome: Proportion of women preferring cesarean section
Factors associated with cesarean section preference
cohort: 1,979 postpartum women with no potential medical need for cesarean section from 32 hospitals in Argentina, Thailand, Vietnam, and Burkina Faso
finding: While the overall cesarean section rate was 23.3%, only 9% of women expressed a preference for it, with primiparous women showing a higher likelihood compared to multiparous women.
country: Argentina, Thailand, Vietnam, and Burkina Faso
